title: Coast Guard rescues 4 people from boat taking on water offshore St. Catherines Sound
description: A Coast Guard Station Tybee Island, Georgia 45-foot Response Boat-Medium crew assists in dewatering a 17-foot vessel taking on water five miles offshore of St.Catherines Sound, Georgia, June 22, 2020. The RB-M crew used a P6 pump to dewater the vessel and towed the vessel to Newport River where they conducted a tow transfer to Sea Tow. (U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Station Tybee Island)
